target_customer: Managed security service providers, MSPs and in-house security teams, originally small and mid-sized businesses
problem: Small teams and service providers struggle to write detection code and run consistent incident response workflows across many customers.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription plus pay-as-you-go investigations billed to the provider (from $249 per month)
product_category: Security delivery and automation platform, built on Microsoft Security

founders.name: Stanislav Golubchik
founders.background_notes: YC page lists about 15 years in IT and cybersecurity, starting in a network operations center; education not listed. Dallas Innovates calls him CEO and co-founder; no other co-founder is named in sources opened.

competitors.name: SpecTrust
competitors.what: No-code platform to deploy and enforce cybercrime defenses without engineering
competitors.funding_then: $4.3M seed led by Cyber Mentor Fund

technical_complexity.rationale: Mapping vulnerabilities to MITRE ATT&CK and automating detection and response across cloud, network and endpoints on Microsoft Sentinel APIs; later multi-tenant AI agents.

defensibility.rationale: Built on Microsoft's platform and competing with funded automation vendors; per-provider workflow libraries add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Microsoft kept adding Sentinel automation, yet ContraForce stayed independent and later pitched itself as a layer on top of Microsoft Security; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Rising ransomware and a shortage of security staff pushed SMBs toward managed providers; ContraForce joined the Microsoft Intelligent Security Association in July 2021.

branding.domain_note: Uses contraforce.com; acquisition details not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and product led, naming features such as Gamebook workflows and Agent Shifts.

branding.community_and_virality: Won an SC Awards 2024 most promising early-stage startup listing and a 2025 CyberSecurity Breakthrough award per aggregator notes; no merch or community evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct compound name but unexplained and similar to a video game brand; industry awards show some recognition, no brand-driven growth evidence.

pivots.from: Self-service no-code security automation for SMBs
pivots.to: Agentic security delivery platform for MSSPs and MSPs
pivots.why: Not stated; company site and YC description now emphasize service providers and AI agents.

outcome_analysis: ContraForce launched at YC Demo Day in August 2021 and raised a $2M seed from DataTribe in December 2021, then a $3.25M seed in October 2024. It moved toward MSSPs and AI agents on top of Microsoft Security and has about 15 to 24 staff per aggregators. Slow, small raises over three years suggest modest traction, but no shutdown or sale was found.
notes: SiliconAngle also cites a 125K pre-seed from Y Combinator via Crunchbase (aggregator, not recorded as a round). The 2021 seed is also reported by MSSP Alert and Fintech Global (search results; MSSP Alert fetch was blocked). Total raised is 5.25M per Dallas Innovates, 5.38M per PitchBook, 6.03M per CB Insights; coverage marked partial. The 2024 round is labeled seed by the sources. The pivot is inferred from the change in site and YC copy, with no stated date. Search for name origin returned unrelated results.
